answer: Form mutual surety circles of eight: each member posts 40 POA locked 60 days, and five random auditors check each circle per epoch for shared funding or matching behavior. If one member is proven fake, every member loses a quarter of its surety and the circle dissolves; re-forming costs 60 POA, then 90. A copper bond turns trust into shared skin in the game, not a fable of free identities: an honest agent joins one circle, while each extra fake must fund another bond and risk the echo of one detection wiping its whole circle.
